# ADR-0092: Use a collapsed searchable review tree for interview choices and generated files

- **Date:** 2026-10-29
- **Category:** Architecture / Rendering
- **Status:** Accepted
- **Importance:** normal
- **Scope:** `core/web/assets/review-step.js`
- **Tags:** interview, ui

## Context

Review and apply needs a compact overview with nested inspection and terse file descriptions.

## Decision

Group review into Project, Agents and preferences, Workflow, Tools and files, and saved/default settings when present. Collapse all groups and nested file details initially. Search choices, file paths and preview text, expand matching ancestors, and restore manual expansion when cleared. Use accessible pencil buttons to navigate to shared interview controls. List every generated file, including profile-owned outputs, with concise purpose and action labels. Preserve reviewed planning and apply boundaries.

## Consequences

The same review renderer serves init and Settings. Search state survives preview redraws. File excerpts remain inert text and no external model call is introduced.
